units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Accepted from the H3 sheets and frame steps: attack v2 with right pad, since v1's lunge cut the snout at the edge in its contact frames; death v2 dense guides on every painted death pose, a continuous sink (v1 lost 24 frames mid-fall); idle v1 head raises are sustained motion; move, hit, defend and cast v1. The idle loops its first guide cycle, video 0-60 every second frame (seam 1.1), so the large figure keeps more action frames in one atlas.
